prompt:
Create a 2 minute 30 second instrumental event piece about a three-body gravitational dance that never quite repeats. Around 118 BPM, E minor. Three staccato string voices, each with its own meter, attract, sling, and scatter. Asymmetric drums appear only in close encounters. Urgent and cold, not a battle anthem. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no lyrics, no hummed melody-as-voice, no singing, no whispered speech. No brass fanfare, no regular four-on-the-floor.

[00:00–00:20] Three sparse voices, separate tempos.
[00:20–00:55] Mutual pull: phrases shorten, drums enter irregularly.
[00:55–01:35] Close triple encounter: densest moment, still contrapuntal, then a sling outward.
[01:35–02:05] One voice ejected to high register; the other two orbit shakily.
[02:05–02:30] All three still moving, no cadence, cut on an unfinished interval.
